text: Skip to main content Free File - Most commonly filed federal forms are available More In File Individuals Who should file Steps to file your taxes File your tax return Free File Get an extension Amend return Your information Life events Students Employees Parents Military Seniors and retirees Businesses and self-employed Charities and nonprofits International taxpayers Governmental liaisons Federal, state and local governments Indian tribal governments Tax exempt bonds Taxpayer identification numbers (TIN) The Free File Alliance offers the most commonly filed forms and schedules for taxpayers. Software companies are not required to support all the federal income tax forms and schedules, and may not offer those forms that are less commonly used. Below is a list of forms and schedules that all the software companies offer. If you need a form or schedule that is not listed below, check the company’s website for more information about the forms provided.
